title: Đạo Đức Kinh (Dao De Jing)
author: Lão Tử (Laozi)
source: Cổ thư Đạo gia Trung Hoa
keyQuote: Đạo thường vô vi nhi vô bất vi. Hầu vương nhược năng thủ chi, vạn vật tương tự hóa.
quote: Đạo thường vô vi nhi vô bất vi. Hầu vương nhược năng thủ chi, vạn vật tương tự hóa.

title: Binh Pháp Tôn Tử (The Art of War)
author: Tôn Vũ (Sun Tzu)
keyQuote: Binh giả, quỷ đạo dã. Tri bỉ tri kỷ, bách chiến bất đãi.
quote: Binh giả, quỷ đạo dã. Tri bỉ tri kỷ, bách chiến bất đãi.

title: Trang Tử - Nam Hoa Kinh (Tề Vật Luận)
author: Trang Chu (Zhuangzi)
keyQuote: Thiên địa dữ ngã tịnh sinh, nhi vạn vật dữ ngã vi nhất (Trời đất cùng ta sinh ra, vạn vật cùng ta là một).
quote: Thiên địa dữ ngã tịnh sinh, nhi vạn vật dữ ngã vi nhất (Trời đất cùng ta sinh ra, vạn vật cùng ta là một).

title: Suy Tưởng (Meditations)
author: Marcus Aurelius
source: Chủ nghĩa Khắc Kỷ La Mã (Penguin Classics)
keyQuote: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
quote: The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.

title: Cẩm Nang Khắc Kỷ (Enchiridion)
author: Epictetus
source: Triết học Hy Lạp - La Mã
keyQuote: Some things are in our control and others not. Things in our control are opinion, pursuit, desire, aversion, and whatever are our own actions.
quote: Some things are in our control and others not. Things in our control are opinion, pursuit, desire, aversion, and whatever are our own actions.

title: The Byzantine Generals Problem
author: Leslie Lamport, Robert Shostak, Marshall Pease
source: ACM Transactions on Programming Languages and Systems (TOPLAS), Vol. 4, No. 3
keyQuote: Reliable computer systems must handle malfunctioning components that give conflicting information to different parts of the system.
quote: Reliable computer systems must handle malfunctioning components that give conflicting information to different parts of the system.

title: Towards Robust Distributed Systems (Brewer's CAP Theorem)
author: Eric A. Brewer
source: ACM Symposium on Principles of Distributed Computing (PODC Keynote)
keyQuote: Shared-data systems can guarantee at most two of the three: Consistency, Availability, and Partition Tolerance.
quote: Shared-data systems can guarantee at most two of the three: Consistency, Availability, and Partition Tolerance.

title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
author: Martin Kleppmann
keyQuote: The fundamental truth about distributed systems is that you cannot avoid network partitions and latency.
quote: The fundamental truth about distributed systems is that you cannot avoid network partitions and latency.

title: Architectural Styles and the Design of Network-based Software Architectures
author: Roy Thomas Fielding
source: Doctoral dissertation, University of California, Irvine
keyQuote: Stateless communication improves visibility, reliability, and scalability.
quote: Stateless communication improves visibility, reliability, and scalability.

title: Google Gemini 2.5 & 3.7 Technical Overview with Real-Time Search Grounding
author: Google DeepMind Team
